newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bond issuance seen at heated pace.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bond issuance seen at heated pace.

text.p: Corporate bond issuance should continue at a heated pace as issuers return from a holiday weekend and capitalize on favorable rates, dealers said.
"Levels are still very good so we should see some strong issuance this week," one syndicate source said on Tuesday.
Although very few names are in the market, dealers said players are currently structuring some deals and expect the new issue environment to shift into high gear.
The U.S. Treasury and fixed-income markets were closed Monday in observance of the Columbus Day holiday.
